tickets.name: First Look
tickets.note: Cavaliers at Hornets, and here's how we see the opening act! Diabate has to deal with Allen in the circle, and that's a tall order, folks! Win that tip and the Cavaliers are first in line to score. If the tip goes the Hornets' way, Allen is the guy we want letting it fly! If that first look rims out, White is right there to clean it up! Any of them scores first, and we're counting money!

tickets.name: Out of the Huddle
tickets.note: Lights up for Lakers at Hawks, and we know exactly who we want touching the ball early! Kessler versus Okongwu for the tip, and Kessler has owned that matchup in the circle! So the Lakers should get the first crack at it. The Hawks get a stop? Then it's Okongwu running the other way for the first two! Only one man in this game beats his price, and it's Okongwu. Let's go!

tickets.name: Top of the Key
tickets.note: Grizzlies and Raptors, and the first bucket of this one has our fingerprints all over it! It starts with Edey against Murray-Boyles at center court, and our money says Edey gets up there first! Advantage Grizzlies for the opening bucket. If Edey controls the tip, he taps it to a guard, rolls to the rim, and boom, he's the first look! If the Raptors get there first, Murray-Boyles is who we want firing! One bucket from any of them and we're cashing. Wakey wakey, eggs and bakey!

tickets.name: Early Offense
tickets.note: Pacers visiting Mavericks, and we've got the opening possessions mapped out! Zubac and Gafford meet in the circle, and Zubac has been winning these jumps all season long! Toss-up at the tip, but we trust the Mavericks to cash the first trip! Washington is the sneaky finisher on that opening trip! Washington stands alone in this one, and that's plenty!

tickets.name: Ice Breaker
tickets.note: Next up, Spurs at Suns, and the first trip down the floor is circled in red! Wembanyama squares up with Ighodaro for the opening tip, and we like Wembanyama to control it! That puts the Spurs on the front foot to get on the board first. If the Suns steal the tip or get the first stop, Ighodaro is who we want firing first! Just one play in this game, and it's Ighodaro all the way!

tickets.name: Lead the Break
tickets.note: Pelicans roll into Warriors territory, and the first minute is all we care about! The jump ball goes Green against Matkovic, and Green has the springs tonight! It's up for grabs, and we're holding a ticket on both teams! Should Green get the tip, the ball comes right back to him. First look, baby! Should the Pelicans grab the first possession, Matkovic is our trigger man! Whoever lights it up first, the split covers the game. Let's ride!
